description: This map displays a false-colour infrared (FCIR) satellite image of a coastal area, enhanced with overlaid land cover classification polygons. The water body is shown in dark blue. Vegetated areas, including forests and dense vegetation, appear in shades of red and pink. Urban fabric, buildings, and impervious surfaces such as roads are rendered in cyan, light blue, or grey. Yellow lines outline the boundaries of various land cover polygons. A specific polygon containing a large, dark-roofed building and surrounding developed and vegetated spaces is labelled "1400" in green text. Based on the surrounding document context which references "Green urban areas" (CORINE Land Cover (CLC) 1.4.1) and "Sport and leisure facilities" (CLC 1.4.2), the label "1400" likely refers to a classification within the CLC 1.4 category: Artificial, non-agricultural vegetated areas. Roads are visible as greenish-yellow lines traversing the landscape. No scale bar, compass orientation, or explicit geographic location is visible within the image.
